name: Microsoft SAT40

timeline.event: Land clearing begins for the site, specifically digging up a parking lot and making outlines for the buildings. Evident on [Google Earth](https://earth.google.com/web/@29.4149522,-98.80304495,292.48816289a,1532.49619452d,35y,0h,0t,0r/).
Building 1 operational. Estimated 3 months out from February, when there was still construction equipment.
Building 2 operational. No more construction on building, and surrounding roads are also complete.
Site has already been completed, with no more visible construction on any building.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Microsoft SAT40: current power 75 MW; owner Microsoft.

explain: Microsoft SAT40 is an operating AI data center in San Antonio, TX, owned by microsoft. Epoch AI estimates it draws 75 MW today and 106 MW when finished.
